The [[Stone Rain Polymock Piece]] is one of the 18 pieces that a player can pick while playing [[Polymock]].

When using this piece, you take the [[Stone Rain Form]].

[[Category:Polymock pieces]]

==Acquisition==
This piece drops as a reward from [[Arachni's Spoils]], [[Fendi's Chest]], [[Oola's Chest]], and the [[Prismatic Chest]].
